vocabulary.meaning_en: Saturday and Sunday, or the days off
vocabulary.example: What do you do on the weekend?
Let's go out for some fresh air.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when water falls from the sky
vocabulary.example: If it rains, we stay home.
I stay home on rainy days.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sleep until a late time in the morning
a small place to drink coffee and eat light food
be with people for some time
vocabulary.example: I spend time with my family.

vocabulary.meaning_en: eat or do something new to see if you like it
vocabulary.example: I like to try new food.
I prepare for the week on Sunday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: put the things you need in your bag
vocabulary.example: I get my bag ready the night before.

fine_lines.title: often vs sometimes vs usually
fine_lines.explanation_ar: usually = عادةً (أغلب الوقت)، often = كثيرًا، sometimes = أحيانًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: usually = most times; often = many times; sometimes = some times.

examples.sentence: I usually meet my sister for lunch.
I often walk in the park.

fine_lines.title: in the morning / afternoon / evening
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نقول in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening، لكن on Saturday و on Sunday evenings (مع اسم اليوم نستخدم on).
fine_lines.explanation_en: We say in the morning/afternoon/evening, but on Saturday / on Sunday evenings.

examples.sentence: In the morning, I walk in the park.
In the evening, I cook dinner.

expressions.phrase: What do you usually do on Saturdays?
expressions.example: What do you usually do on Saturdays? I visit my family.

expressions.meaning_en: Say this before you think of an answer.
expressions.example: What is your favorite day? That is a good question.

expressions.phrase: It makes me feel calm and happy.
expressions.meaning_en: Say how something makes you feel.
expressions.example: Walking by the sea makes me feel calm and happy.
I read in the garden. That sounds very relaxing.

expressions.phrase: If it rains, I stay home.
expressions.meaning_en: Talk about a plan for bad weather.
expressions.example: If it rains, I stay home and read.

expressions.phrase: It is always nice to spend time together.
expressions.meaning_ar: من الجميل دائمًا قضاء الوقت معًا.
expressions.meaning_en: Say you enjoy time with others.
expressions.example: We visit our cousins. It is always nice to spend time together.

expressions.phrase: It helps me feel ready for Monday.
expressions.meaning_ar: يساعدني على أن أشعر بالاستعداد ليوم الاثنين.
expressions.example: I plan my week. It helps me feel ready for Monday.

expressions.phrase: Maybe next Saturday we can go to a cafe together.
expressions.meaning_ar: ربما السبت القادم يمكننا الذهاب إلى مقهى معًا.
expressions.example: Maybe next Saturday we can go to the park together.

grammar.title: Present simple with frequency words
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للعادات مع usually, often, sometimes. تأتي usually و often قبل الفعل، و sometimes يمكن أن تأتي أول الجملة.
examples: In the morning, I often walk in the park.
In the afternoon, I usually meet my sister.

grammar.title: If + present, present (real habits)
grammar.explanation_ar: If + المضارع، ثم المضارع: لشيء يحدث دائمًا عندما يحدث شرط: If it rains, I stay home.
grammar.explanation_en: If + present, present: what you always do in a situation.
examples: If it rains, I stay home and watch a movie.
If I'm tired, I sleep early.
If the weather is nice, we walk.

grammar.title: make + someone + feel/adjective
grammar.explanation_ar: make + شخص + feel + صفة: It makes me feel calm. أو make + شخص + صفة: Cooking makes me happy.
examples: It makes me feel calm and happy.

questions.question: What do you usually do ___ Saturdays?
___ the morning, I often walk in the park.

questions.explanation_ar: sleep late = ينام حتى وقت متأخر.

questions.question: On Sunday evenings, I ___ for the week.
I walk in the park. — That sounds very ___.
questions.explanation_en: We describe the activity as relaxing.

questions.question: It is always nice to ___ time together.
Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I go often to the cafe.
Often I goes to the cafe.
I often goes to the cafe.
I often go to the cafe.
questions.explanation_ar: often قبل الفعل، والفعل مع I بدون s.
questions.explanation_en: Often goes before the verb; no -s with I.
